name: Catte
description:
This is Catte, a cafe where pretty cats work.
They serve incredibly delicious coffee, so be careful not to order too much.  It's a must-follow trick-taking game where you aim to collect cards without exceeding your limit.

The Japanese listing explains further:

Gameplay

Must-follow trick-taking with three card colors (black, white, brown) and sets combining to form other colors.

Each trick awards a coffee card for points.

Exceeding a set score limit (“burst”) ends the round with no points for the bursting player.

Changes to trick rules come from special cards that can alter whether you must follow, must not follow, etc.
